name: TerraScoutX Property API
description:
Free for everyone. Each API key gets 2,000 requests per calendar month (UTC). Get a key at https://terrascoutx.com/developers/ and send it in the X-Api-Key header. marketValue and totalAppraised are the county's appraised value from its latest tax roll, not an automated current-market estimate. Coverage and the fields present vary by county; a field the county does not publish is omitted rather than filled with a guess.

DATA TERMS. The records are compiled from county and other public sources. They are not open data and are not released under an open license (no CC0, CC-BY or ODbL). The terms of each source county vary. Do not assume you may redistribute the data in bulk; check the source's terms if you plan to.

OWNER FIELDS. owner, mailingAddress and ownershipTransfers (buyer and seller names) identify private individuals. They are public-record data in most states, but some states restrict or exempt them. Integrations should not consume or display them. Add no_owner=1 to /v1/suggest or /v1/property/{id} to leave them out, or fields= to list exactly the fields you want.
